description: Puts the person’s brand on a design: its colours by role (primary, accent, background, text, secondary — each replaced everywhere), the faces of their team’s brand kit (heading face on headlines, body face on the rest) and the brand name in the wordmark. Reads the brand kit itself; colours you pass win. Use it for «use my brand colours», «make it on-brand». Example: { design, colours: { primary: «#0b3d2e», accent: «#f2b705» }, brand: «Kava» }. Or the brand from their logo (`file` or `image_url`): its colours and the logo placed.

brand.description: the brand name for the wordmark

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

file.description: ChatGPT fills it: the picture the person attached in this chat { download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name }; fetched once, kept with this design only

image_url.description: the person’s picture: an https link or a data: URL (PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ ~180 KB); one you cannot pass: upload_picture — never describe or redraw it

picture_is.description: photo (fills the photo frame), product or person (cut out, in the cut-out place), logo (a corner + its colours as the brand’s); auto (default): read from the file

use_kit.description: false: ignore the team’s brand kit (default true)

name: apply_brand
title: Apply my brand
